heading: **29 November 2025**
body:
Based on quantification of cycle 3 PCR samples → a maximum concentration of 5-6 ng/uL was seen for the overall sample → since 5 uL of the PCR2 will be used for cycle 4 during the foot printing assay i.e. about 30 ng per well.

We have consistently been using 0.5 uL of *Hia5* for treating \~300 ng DNA. By this context, 0.05 uL of the enzyme to be used for 30 ng i.e. per well.

Approximately we want to use 8 uL of Hia5 distributed across 384 wells → this equates to about 0.021 uL per well.

For testing → Take 0.5 uL of enzyme and dilute to 24 uL in Hia5 buffer

8X reactions:

Hia5 x 8: 240 ng DNA \+ Hia5 buffer \+ 1 uL dHia5 \+ 0.5 uL SAM (Distribute 20 uL samples per tube)

| 37 C | 1 hour |
| :---- | :---- |
| 80 C | 10 mins |
